title: IN THE MATTER OF SOUTHWESTERN PUBLIC SERVICE COMPANY’S APPLICATION FOR AUTHORITY TO: (1) ISSUE UP TO $3.5 BILLION OF FIRST MORTGAGE BONDS DURING 2027; (2) RECOVER CERTAIN REFUNDING COSTS; AND (3) ENTER INTO AGREEMENTS IN SUPPORT OF INTEREST RATE HEDGING INCLUDING INTEREST RATE LOCKS AND SWAPS; (4) TO EXTEND THE REVOLVING CREDIT AGREEMENT FOR AN ADDITIONAL TWO YEARS; AND (5) INCREASE THE MAXIMUM AMOUNT OF ITS CREDIT AGREEMENT TO $1,200,000,000.
